name: browser-use
headline: Zen - Optimize Claude Usage
short_description: Optimize Claude Code CLI, Gemini, and Codex usage by analyzing metadata in logs. Reduces costs and frustration without affecting prompt quality. Ideal for operations teams managing AI workflows.
author: netra-systems

sections.overview:
Zen extends your Claude usage by analyzing logs for optimization opportunities focused on metadata rather than semantics, ensuring no quality loss. The tool identifies actionable improvements in your Claude Code commands, prompts, and settings through one-time setup and a single command. It supports Claude, Gemini, and Codex logs, making it accessible across different CLI tools. Developers and operations teams can reduce API costs while maintaining output quality by implementing the specific optimizations Zen recommends. The tool is designed for individual developers first, with enterprise-scale optimizations planned for future releases.
Reduce Claude API costs by identifying metadata inefficiencies in usage logs
Optimize Claude Code commands and prompts based on actual usage patterns
Analyze Gemini and Codex logs for CLI-agnostic cost savings
Help ops teams audit and improve AI workflow configurations
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/netra-systems/zen`
sections.usage:
```
Analyze my Claude Code CLI, Gemini, and Codex usage logs to identify optimization opportunities. Focus on reducing costs while maintaining prompt quality. Here are the logs: [LOGS]. Provide specific recommendations for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector.
```
